verses.t: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
verses.pickthall: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall
verses.yusufAli: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall
verses.rodwell: A SUITOR sued for punishment to light suddenly
verses.sale: One demanded and called for vengeance to fall on the unbelievers

verses.t: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer
verses.pickthall: Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel
verses.yusufAli: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off
verses.rodwell: On the infidels: none can hinder
verses.sale: There shall be none to avert the same

verses.t: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent
verses.pickthall: From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways
verses.yusufAli: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent
verses.rodwell: God from inflicting it, the master of those ASCENTS
verses.sale: from being inflicted by God, the possessor of the steps

verses.t: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years
verses.pickthall: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years
verses.yusufAli: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years
verses.rodwell: By which the angels and the spirit ascend to him in a day, whose length is fifty thousand years
verses.sale: by which the angels ascend unto Him, and the spirit Gabriel also, in a day whose space is fifty thousand years

verses.t: So be patient with gracious patience
verses.pickthall: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see
verses.yusufAli: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment)
verses.rodwell: Be thou patient therefore with becoming patience
verses.sale: Wherefore bear the insults of the Meccans with becoming patience

verses.t: Indeed, they see it [as] distant
verses.pickthall: Lo! they behold it afar off
verses.yusufAli: They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event)
verses.rodwell: They forsooth regard that day as distant
verses.sale: for they see their punishment afar off

verses.t: But We see it [as] near
verses.pickthall: While we behold it nigh
verses.yusufAli: But We see it (quite) near
verses.rodwell: But we see it nigh
verses.sale: but We see it nigh at hand

verses.t: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil
verses.pickthall: The day when the sky will become as molten copper
verses.yusufAli: The Day that the sky will be like molten brass
verses.rodwell: The day when the heavens shall become as molten brass
verses.sale: On a certain day the heaven shall become like molten brass

verses.t: And the mountains will be like wool
verses.pickthall: And the hills become as flakes of wool
verses.yusufAli: And the mountains will be like wool
verses.rodwell: And the mountains shall become like flocks of wool
verses.sale: and the mountains like wool of various colours, scattered abroad by the wind

verses.t: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend
verses.pickthall: And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend
verses.yusufAli: And no friend will ask after a friend
verses.rodwell: And friend shall not question of friend
verses.sale: And a friend shall not ask a friend concerning his condition, although

verses.t: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
verses.pickthall: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children
verses.yusufAli: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children
verses.rodwell: Though they look at one another. Fain would the wicked redeem himself from punishment on that day at the price of his children
verses.sale: they see one another. The wicked shall wish to redeem himself from the punishment of that day, by giving up his children

verses.t: And his wife and his brother
verses.pickthall: And his spouse and his brother
verses.yusufAli: His wife and his brother
verses.rodwell: Of his spouse and his brother
verses.sale: and his wife, and his brother

verses.t: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
verses.pickthall: And his kin that harboured him
verses.yusufAli: His kindred who sheltered him
verses.rodwell: And of his kindred who shewed affection for him
verses.sale: and his kindred who shewed kindness unto him

verses.t: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him
verses.pickthall: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him
verses.yusufAli: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him
verses.rodwell: And of all who are on the earth that then it might deliver him
verses.sale: and all who are in the earth; and that this might deliver him

verses.t: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell]
verses.pickthall: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell
verses.yusufAli: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell
verses.rodwell: But no. For the fire
verses.sale: By no means: For hell fire

verses.t: A remover of exteriors
verses.pickthall: Eager to roast
verses.yusufAli: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull
verses.rodwell: Dragging by the scalp
verses.sale: dragging them by their scalps

verses.t: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
verses.pickthall: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth)
verses.yusufAli: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right)
verses.rodwell: Shall claim him who turned his back and went away
verses.sale: shall call him who shall have turned his back, and fled from the faith

verses.t: And collected [wealth] and hoarded
verses.pickthall: And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it
verses.yusufAli: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)
verses.rodwell: And amassed and hoarded
verses.sale: and shall have amassed riches, and covetously hoarded them

verses.t: Indeed, mankind was created anxious
verses.pickthall: Lo! man was created anxious
verses.yusufAli: Truly man was created very impatient
verses.rodwell: Man truly is by creation hasty
verses.sale: Verily man is created extremely impatient

verses.t: When evil touches him, impatient
verses.pickthall: Fretful when evil befalleth him
verses.yusufAli: Fretful when evil touches him
verses.rodwell: When evil befalleth him, impatient
verses.sale: When evil toucheth him, he is full of complaint

verses.t: And when good touches him, withholding [of it]
verses.pickthall: And, when good befalleth him, grudging
verses.yusufAli: And niggardly when good reaches him
verses.rodwell: But when good falleth to his lot, tenacious
verses.sale: but when good befalleth him, he becometh niggardly

verses.t: Except the observers of prayer
verses.pickthall: Save worshippers
verses.yusufAli: Not so those devoted to Prayer
verses.rodwell: Not so the prayerful
verses.sale: Except those who are devoutly given

verses.t: Those who are constant in their prayer
verses.pickthall: Who are constant at their worship
verses.yusufAli: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer
verses.rodwell: Who are ever constant at their prayers
verses.sale: and who persevere in their prayers

verses.t: And those within whose wealth is a known right
verses.pickthall: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged
verses.yusufAli: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right
verses.rodwell: And of whose substance there is a due and stated portion
verses.sale: and those of whose substance a due and certain portion is ready to be given

verses.t: For the petitioner and the deprived
verses.pickthall: For the beggar and the destitute
verses.yusufAli: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking)
verses.rodwell: For him who asketh, and for him who is ashamed to beg
verses.sale: unto him who asketh, and him who is forbidden by shame to ask

verses.t: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
verses.pickthall: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment
verses.yusufAli: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment
verses.rodwell: And who own the judgment - day a truth
verses.sale: And those who sincerely believe the day of judgment

verses.t: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord
verses.pickthall: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom
verses.yusufAli: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord
verses.rodwell: And who thrill with dread at the chastisement of their Lord
verses.sale: and who dread the punishment of their Lord

verses.t: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe
verses.pickthall: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure
verses.yusufAli: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity
verses.rodwell: For there is none safe from the chastisement of their Lord
verses.sale: For there is none secure from the punishment of their Lord

verses.t: And those who guard their private parts
verses.pickthall: And those who preserve their chastity
verses.yusufAli: And those who guard their chastity
verses.rodwell: And who control their desires
verses.sale: And who abstain from the carnal knowledge

verses.t: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed
verses.pickthall: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy
verses.yusufAli: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed
verses.rodwell: Save with their wives or the slaves whom their right hands have won, for there they shall be blameless
verses.sale: of women other than their wives, or the slaves which their right hands possess; -- for as to them they shall be blameless

verses.t: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors
verses.pickthall: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors
verses.yusufAli: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors
verses.rodwell: But whoever indulge their desires beyond this are transgressors
verses.sale: but whoever coveteth any woman besides these, they are transgressors

verses.t: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
verses.pickthall: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant
verses.yusufAli: And those who respect their trusts and covenants
verses.rodwell: And who are true to their trusts and their engagements
verses.sale: And those who faithfully keep what they are intrusted with, and their covenant

verses.t: And those who are in their testimonies upright
verses.pickthall: And those who stand by their testimony
verses.yusufAli: And those who stand firm in their testimonies
verses.rodwell: And who witness uprightly
verses.sale: and who are upright in their testimonies

verses.t: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer
verses.pickthall: And those who are attentive at their worship
verses.yusufAli: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship
verses.rodwell: And who keep strictly the hours of prayer
verses.sale: and who carefully observe the requisite rites in their prayers

verses.t: They will be in gardens, honored
verses.pickthall: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured
verses.yusufAli: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss)
verses.rodwell: These shall dwell, laden with honours, amid gardens
verses.sale: These shall dwell amidst gardens, highly honoured

verses.t: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad]
verses.pickthall: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed
verses.yusufAli: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee
verses.rodwell: But what hath come to the unbelievers that they run at full stretch around thee
verses.sale: What aileth the unbelievers, that they run before thee

verses.t: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups
verses.pickthall: On the right and on the left, in groups
verses.yusufAli: From the right and from the left, in crowds
verses.rodwell: On the right hand and on the left, in bands
verses.sale: in companies, on the right hand and on the left

verses.t: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure
verses.pickthall: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight
verses.yusufAli: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss
verses.rodwell: Is it that every man of them would fain enter that garden of delights
verses.sale: Doth every man of them wish to enter into a garden of delight

verses.t: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know
verses.pickthall: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know
verses.yusufAli: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know
verses.rodwell: Not at all. We have created them, they know of what
verses.sale: By no means: Verily We have created them of that which they know

verses.t: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
verses.pickthall: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able
verses.yusufAli: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly
verses.rodwell: It needs not that I swear by the Lord of the East and of the West that we have power
verses.sale: I swear by the Lord of the east and of the west, that We are able to destroy them

verses.t: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone
verses.pickthall: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun
verses.yusufAli: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan)
verses.rodwell: To replace them with better than themselves: neither are we to be hindered
verses.sale: and to substitute better than them in their room; neither are We to be prevented, if We shall please so to do

verses.t: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised
verses.pickthall: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised
verses.yusufAli: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised
verses.rodwell: Wherefore let them flounder on and disport them, till they come face to face with their threatened day
verses.sale: Wherefore suffer them to wade in vain disputes, and to amuse themselves with sport: Until they meet their day with which they have been threatened

verses.t: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening
verses.pickthall: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal
verses.yusufAli: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them)
verses.rodwell: The day on which they shall flock up out of their graves in haste like men who rally to a standard
verses.sale: the day whereon they shall come forth hastily from their graves, as though they were troops hastening to their standard

verses.t: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised
verses.pickthall: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised
verses.yusufAli: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised
verses.rodwell: Their eyes downcast; disgrace shall cover them. Such their threatened day
verses.sale: Their looks shall be downcast; ignominy shall attend them. This is the day with which they have been threatened
